sources.title: Sims Limited Announces Fiscal 2026 Full Year Results
sources.excerpt:
Sims Limited announced FY26 sales revenue of $8,007.5 million, up 6.9% (10.9% at constant currency) from $7,494.0 million in FY25. Revenue growth was supported by a 6.1% uplift in Metal average sales prices (10.0% at constant currency), reflecting a greater contribution from non-ferrous sales, together with 2.6% growth in overall Metal sales volumes, including brokerage.
